label: Frontend missing imported JSON editor helper
instruction: Complete the missing local JSON editor helper imported by your generated LeaveAdminPage. Generate a single TSX file exporting useJsonEditor(value: any, onChange: (value: any) => void), returning the editor UI as a React node. Keep compatible with the supplied existing calls and Mantine7. No network requests, workflow logic changes, additional dependencies or tests. Do not change the admin page behavior. Maximum50 lines.
